Vivek / Laura — forwarding Stellaris' ask. TL;DR: customer requests a temporary marketplace rev-share reduction to 7% (standard 15%) and Net-60 on initial invoices for first 6 months; also asks pilot credits be excluded from fee basis for 90 days. They are targeting ~ $650K ARR year one and want the private listing live by July 1.

Key considerations for exec:
- Financial impact: at $650K ARR, rev-share delta (15% -> 7%) is ~ $52K in fee difference annually.
- Commercial: getting Stellaris as a marketplace banner customer helps credibility in health vertical (case study potential).
- Risk: Net-60 increases collections risk; pilot-credit carveout could reduce tracked revenue and complicate reporting.

Can we get a one-time waiver on marketplace rev-share and short-term Net-60? If yes, we will require a 24-month minimum listing term and pre-agreed usage floor (monthly minimum consumption) to protect economics. Laura — please advise on redline language to limit exposure. Vivek — can you weigh in on sales/ops impact? Jenna — cc'ing you so you see internal owners.

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik — reviewed the draft and highlighted the highest-risk items. Summary below; redlines attached (Stellaris_Redlines_v2.docx).

Risks & recommended guardrails:
- Rev-share reduction: acceptable as a one-time commercial concession if we secure a 24-month listing term and a 12-month irrevocable minimum spend commitment (we can do a prorated true-up if they underdeliver).
- Net-60: limit to Net-45 for the first three invoices, conditional on finance approval; require autopay/credit check and a letter of credit if they request Net-60 beyond the pilot window.
- Pilot credits carveout: accept but cap the excluded credits to $50k or 10% of first-quarter consumption (whichever is lower) and explicitly exclude promotional credits from the fee calculation.
- Reporting / audit: include a right-to-audit clause for marketplace-reported usage and require monthly reconciliations.

If you want to proceed with an exec ask, I suggest we package the concession with: commit term 24 months, minimum monthly consumption floor of $40k, finance pre-approval for credit extension, and a signed addendum to the standard marketplace agreement.

I will prepare tracked redlines and a one-page executive summary for approval.

Laura Bennett

Thanks for the summary and the redlines. I support a narrow, conditional exception to accelerate this booking. Approvals:

1) Rev-share: approve temporary reduction to 8% (not 7%) for the first 12 months of listing, reverting to standard 15% thereafter.
2) Term: require a 24-month listing commitment with a minimum monthly consumption floor of $40k, with quarterly true-ups and a clawback if minimums are not met in year one.
3) Payment: approve Net-45 for the first three invoices; any extension to Net-60 requires finance signoff and a signed credit instrument (LOC or personal guarantee).
4) Pilot credits carveout: allow exclusion up to $50k as Laura recommended, with explicit reporting and audit rights.

Conditions: legal to finalize tracked redlines; finance to sign off on credit exposure before DocuSign. Ops to ensure marketplace listing configuration will enforce the fee schedule and reporting. Please prepare the final addendum and DocuSign package; copy me on the envelope.

Marissa Cole
